findings.criterion: 1 — resident can share a QR parking pass
findings.issue: The reachable text-only Web Share branch returns after sharing title/text. Although the text now appends the signed OPP2 token, it contains no QR image and no guest-view link that renders a QR; the guest therefore cannot present anything the attendant camera can scan. The pure plan/message tests do not execute SharePass or prove cross-device presentation.
findings.consequence: On browsers with navigator.share but without file sharing, Share appears to succeed while the guest receives raw token text rather than the required scannable QR pass.
findings.correction: Share a short-lived guest URL that keeps the signed token in the fragment and renders the QR client-side, or otherwise ensure this branch transfers the QR artifact instead of returning after text-only share. Add a component/browser test for file-share, text-only-share, and no-Share fallbacks and prove the guest artifact reaches scanner/redeem.

findings.criterion: 2 and 3 — scanned pass prefill plus camera plate check-in correctness
findings.issue: LiveCamera intentionally invokes QR and plate callbacks from the same live-reading loop. usePass awaits lookup using a render-time flow snapshot, while onPlate can update the current plate and navigate to confirm. If a no-hint pass lookup completes after that plate read, passAcceptPatch sees the stale pre-read state and the unconditional plate: patch.plate write clears the freshly scanned plate. The confirm view has no plate editor and its Confirm button is enabled even with an empty plate. The new pure helper tests cover only serial snapshots and cannot expose this race.
findings.consequence: Under ordinary camera plus network timing, a valid pass/plate scan can land on an uneditable confirm screen with the plate erased, preventing or invalidating check-in.
findings.correction: Apply pass acceptance atomically against the latest FlowState (reducer/functional update), guard or cancel competing/stale camera and lookup completions, and never overwrite an independently captured latest plate for a no-hint pass. Disable confirmation without a plate and provide an edit/back path. Add a deferred-lookup regression test where onPlate wins before the no-hint pass response.

findings.criterion: 2 plus accessibility — prepopulate, verify, edit, focus, and submit in context
findings.issue: The banner focus/reveal code is plausible, but recorded execution still consists only of pure mapping/provenance tests. No rendered test scans or enters a signed hinted pass, observes the labeled editable plate UI and focus result, edits it, submits, and verifies the stored plate/pass association.
findings.consequence: The required user-facing prepopulate/verify/submit path and its keyboard/screen-reader transition remain unverified.
findings.correction: Add and record a browser/component integration test for a signed hinted pass through accepted-banner focus, visible plate editing, redemption, and persisted association, including replacement/removal state transitions.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — camera plate scanning fills check-in and checkout
findings.issue: The implementer explicitly did not run the fake-camera stories. The existing live-plate story covers check-in only, and no fake-camera checkout story exists; pure ALPR tests do not execute getUserMedia through the React callbacks and fields.
findings.consequence: Actual camera-to-field behavior for both required flows remains unverified in context.
findings.correction: Run and record the fake-camera check-in story, add and run an equivalent checkout story that opens a session and reaches the correct review from the scanned plate without manual entry, and record browser, viewport, fixture/model, field assertion, and result.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 plus responsive UX — admin CRUD and Super Admin cross-property operations
findings.issue: The required rendered CRUD/role/property stories were explicitly not run. Moreover, crud and people-roles use desktop contexts; people-roles switches a Super Admin to another property but performs no CRUD there, and no browser assertion proves a regular admin cannot cross the tenant boundary.
findings.consequence: The user-facing, mobile-responsive ability to complete all required entity operations at the correct property scope is not established.
findings.correction: Run and record the existing stories; extend them at a narrow mobile viewport to perform representative person/site/unit/slot CRUD, perform edit/delete after a Super Admin switches to a second property, and assert a regular admin cannot read or mutate that second property.
